newsitem.title: UK: Mexico adds 500 mln DEM to Sept 2004 step-up bond.
newsitem.headline: Mexico adds 500 mln DEM to Sept 2004 step-up bond.

text.p: Mexico has added 500 million marks to its structured mark bond due September 2004, lead manager Dresdner Bank said on Monday.
The new paper was priced at 100.10.
The deal has an investor put option at par after five years after which the coupon steps up to 10.875 percent from 8.125 percent in the first five years.
The total size of the deal is now 1.5 billion marks.
